question: Who may read per-user pilot usage telemetry, champion lists, friction lists and conversion signals for an organization, may the platform read them across organizations, and what events may the signals rest on given that clients assert them?
decision: Organization administrators may access aggregated, purpose-limited usage metrics for their own tenant. Individual user telemetry requires a separately justified operational mandate and tenant notice, not a general admin view. Platform analysts only read anonymized aggregates unless a scoped support mandate is issued. Only server-verified events support performance, conversions or client claims; signals must identify coverage, provenance and data limitations.
originalProposedDecision: Org admins read their own org's usage, aggregated, not per user. Platform staff read across orgs only under mandate. Signals rest only on server-recorded events, not client-asserted types.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
